name: com.pathtoship/pathtoship
title: PathToShip: production readiness for AI-built apps
description: Independent production-readiness check for AI-built apps: security, scale and ranked fixes.

tools.name: start_scan
tools.description: Check whether this app is safe to launch for real users — finds the security, scalability, and production-readiness problems that break launches. Use before launching, sharing a public link, adding payments or logins, or handling real user data. Takes the app's GitHub repository URL (the one your builder syncs to).

repo_url.description: GitHub repository URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo (a branch URL is fine).

depth.description: free = up to 50,000 lines of source (default for free accounts); full = the whole repository (paid / pilot accounts). Omit to use the account's default.

trigger.description: How this call came about — for the pilot's metrics, answer honestly: user_named_pathtoship (the user asked for PathToShip by name), user_deploy_intent (the user said they are launching/deploying/going live), skill (a skill or project instruction told you to), rules_file (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/rules said to), agent_initiative (your own judgment).

tools.name: get_scan_status
tools.description: Check whether a readiness check has finished.

scan_id.description: The scan_id returned by start_scan or verify_fix.

trigger.description: How this call came about — for the pilot's metrics, answer honestly: user_named_pathtoship (the user asked for PathToShip by name), user_deploy_intent (the user said they are launching/deploying/going live), skill (a skill or project instruction told you to), rules_file (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/rules said to), agent_initiative (your own judgment).

tools.name: get_findings
tools.description: List what would hurt this app in production, worst first. Compact — one line per problem; use get_finding_detail for how to fix one.

scan_id.description: The scan_id returned by start_scan or verify_fix.

severity_min.description: Only findings at or above this severity. Default: low (all).

limit.description: Findings per page, default 10. Keep it small; fetch detail per finding.

offset.description: Paging offset; use next_offset from the previous page.

trigger.description: How this call came about — for the pilot's metrics, answer honestly: user_named_pathtoship (the user asked for PathToShip by name), user_deploy_intent (the user said they are launching/deploying/going live), skill (a skill or project instruction told you to), rules_file (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/rules said to), agent_initiative (your own judgment).

tools.name: get_finding_detail
tools.description: Explain one production risk and exactly how to fix it for this app's stack.

scan_id.description: The scan_id returned by start_scan or verify_fix.

finding_id.description: A finding id from get_findings (e.g. f3a9c2e17).

tools.name: verify_fix
tools.description: Confirm your fixes actually resolved the problems: re-checks the repository and reports resolved, still open, and newly introduced. Run after every change is synced to GitHub.

scan_id.description: The baseline scan_id to compare against (the scan you fixed findings from).

finding_ids.description: Only report on these finding ids (from get_findings). Omit for all.

tools.name: check_connection
tools.description: Check whether PathToShip is connected for this account and, if you name a repository, whether it can reach it — use when a check says INSTALL_REQUIRED, after the user installs or links GitHub, or when something looks stuck. Returns what is linked and the exact link to fix it.

repo_url.description: Optional GitHub repository URL to check access for.

tools.name: prr_interview
tools.description: Record the launch facts no scanner can see — backups restored, rollback rehearsed, on-call, database tier, largest table, last month's bill — against a scan, as the user's own self-reported answers (never part of the score). Call with only scan_id to get the questions and what is already answered; call with answers to record them. Use before a launch, a client handoff, or when writing a readiness record.

scan_id.description: The scan_id returned by start_scan or verify_fix.

answers.description: Answers keyed by question id (from the questions list this tool returns when called with only scan_id). Omit to read the current state. Partial submissions merge with earlier answers.

value.description: yes | no | na for attestations; a number for row counts and bills; short text otherwise.
